### Class Features (Level Progression)

#### Fighter
- Level 1: Fighting Style, Second Wind
- Level 2: Action Surge (1/day)
- Level 3: Martial Archetype
- Level 5: Extra Attack
- Level 7: Indomitable

#### Wizard
- Level 1: Arcane Recovery
- Level 2: School Tradition
- Level 3: Metamagic (2)
- Level 5: Ability Score Improvement
- Level 7: Metamagic (3)

#### Cleric
- Level 1: Divine Domain
- Level 2: Channel Divinity
- Level 3: Destroy Undead
- Level 5: Divine Strike
- Level 7: Divine Intervention
